items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: Interviewee mentions Hip Henley in the context of job history at Hunnysuckle Inn and 25 Cent Club, but does not describe a direct personal or professional interaction with Hip Henley himself.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. And then when it took Cherokee's job away from him at Hunnysuckle Inn when Hip couldn't
play or sing. Well who was... Who was... Who was... Who was...
